RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel does not prove discrimination on its own, but it increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, particularly given your stronger technical qualifications. However, director-level municipal appointments often heavily weigh interview performance, political alignment, and community engagement experience over degrees and licenses.

Do not raise gender bias directly yet. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your debrief. Alleging discrimination prematurely can harm your reputation within local government networks. If the municipality stonewalls you or provides vague, inconsistent rationales that suggest pretext, consult an employment lawyer or submit a public records request for interview notes and scoring rubrics to determine whether to file a formal complaint.
